question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A group of people who have no permanent abode but wander from place to place
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e. **'Nomad'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that can substitute the given group of words *"A group of people who have no permanent abode but wander from place to place" *is option 2) **'Nomad'.**
 
• A** 'Nomad' **refers to a member of a group of people who have no fixed home and move according to the seasons from place to place in search of food, water, and grazing land.(ख़ानाबदोश)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Nomad'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the explanations for all the words in English and Hindi:
 
 
• **'Truant' **- A student who stays away from school without leave or explanation (बिगड़ैल, अनुपस्थित विद्यार्थी).
 
• **'Ponderer' -** A person who thinks carefully about something (विचारकर्ता).
 
• **'Usurer'** - A person who lends money at unreasonably high rates of interest (सूदखोर).
